frozen_note: Chosen on PUBLIC validation only (tune.py, results/tuning_validation.csv), frozen before predicting observations/. Do not edit.

selection.lr_iters: plain attack, lowest mean MSE on the sigma = 0 validation files (where plain is informative)
selection.prior_factor: grid 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10 on the 9 DP validation files; 1.0 lowest mean MSE (0.04463) and equal to the MAP weighting
selection.sigma0_prior: spec uses factor * sigma^2, which is 0 without noise; a small floor (1e-4, 1e-3) only hurt on validation
selection.submitted_attack: lowest validation MSE among plain / prior / public mean on the eps_4 validation files
